scope: Bounded first-pass discovery of official publication and reuse routes, EU/EEA and Swiss residence routes, the distinct Spanish-national family route, forms and filing, visas and consular practice, administrative remedies, public access, privacy, oversight, legal aid, civil-status evidence, and selected courts. This is not a complete inventory or a legal-equivalence opinion.
retrieval_status: 30 candidate pages converted; 0 PDFs preserved without text extraction; 4 discovery surfaces had no stable body; failures are recorded per item; no source accepted

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU free-movement residence regulation and official guidance
comparison_seed.relationship_note: Real Decreto 240/2007 is a close functional match for EU/EEA free-movement residence administration, but has distinct Spanish scope and implementing rules. Spain's Swiss route is based on the EU–Swiss Agreement and Spanish administrative application; EEA EFTA coverage is treaty-based. Families of Spanish nationals who have not exercised free movement have a distinct route under Real Decreto 1155/2024. Similarity labels do not establish legal equivalence.

previous_findings_carried_forward: Prior Danish, Swedish, Finnish, Austrian, Czech, Slovenian, Polish, Hungarian and other country findings are discovery leads only; verify each Spanish candidate at its first-party publisher.
Compare legislation, guidance, forms, consular practice, remedies, public access, privacy, oversight, legal aid, family-status evidence and case law separately.

Public API documentation, open-data law, stable identifiers and downloadable PDFs do not alone establish live access, complete version resolution, reuse permission for every content class, or deterministic conversion.
Preserve EU, EEA EFTA, Swiss, Spanish-national, UK Withdrawal Agreement and ordinary third-country routes as distinct where their legal bases or procedures differ.
A bounded central-government search does not establish coverage of autonomous-community law, offices, oversight institutions, or their multilingual publication channels.
